items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the sharpened version of the comparison between the limit topology and the I-adic topology on M = lim H^p(C, F_n), with the ascending chain condition now imposed on the graded module of the stable images N_n (statement lines 4940-4961). The proof follows the companion argument of the same chapter, and its own content is the use of the sharpened hypothesis to control an element of the neighbourhoods through finitely many stable images (proof lines 4963-5002). The non-formal content is the substitution of the stable images for the full cohomology groups. The claim is H2: a variant whose proof is the companion proof with one ingredient sharpened.
